answer: Mark you this: the harbour fills with masks, yet only one pier stands true. Each player must build its own pier from timber it felled itself, then win welcome at three far ports, each an oasis across the lagoon — no cluster may vouch for its own kin. Ten masks sharing one purse raise one pier and beg at one shore: together they weigh 1, while one honest player, welcomed at three ports, weighs 100. One true face outshines a painted chorus.
